title: Investor who called for AI pivot in 2023 says bitcoin is going to $57,000
summary: Jason Calacanis wants investors to sell bitcoin and back artificial intelligence. He is also holding TAO, the cryptocurrency behind AI network Bittensor.

title: Now is the time to accumulate bitcoin, Galaxy says
summary: Galaxy argues improving price trends, resilient ETF demand and rising U.S. debt support bitcoin’s recovery towards its previous high.

title: An AI label alone no longer wins lenders, JPMorgan says
summary: As default insurance on several AI-linked firms hits record costs, companies must show they can finance investment, service the debt and eventually mint cash, JPMorgan says.

title: Solana bug reports now cost 1 SOL as AI floods security teams with spam
summary: Researchers must now permanently burn 1 SOL for every submission after a monthlong contest drew 809 reports, with AI believed to have helped generate or write nearly all of them.

title: Ethereum fixes Glamsterdam bug that could have sent staking deposits to builders
summary: Developers initially rejected the change before reversing course, as testing delays gave them more time to examine a flaw in Ethereum's upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade.
